_notes: The site's colours for the owner to edit (2026-11-26). "main": the ones changed one or two at a time, each by a plain name, its light and dark value, the token pages use and who or what it marks; below, the rest by token name ("_what" says what each is). core.LoadUI adds every one to ui.json's tokens, so every page, the .io's ui.css and the evaluation report take them. Hex #rrggbb. In VS Code every value has a swatch: click it for a colour picker (colors.schema.json). After a change: make dev-build, then cd server && go run ./cmd/uicss > core/testdata/golden/ui.css (the golden test). One colour means one thing everywhere: green OK or passed, deep green Outstanding, red failed; the one exception is your Holy graph's passed projects, in the intra's blue (done).

piscine.is: Pisciners: anyone in or after a C Piscine who wasn't admitted. People's nodes and tags, the Piscine part of Profile's path, the period dot, Stats' "not admitted".

common-core.is: Common Core students (cadets). People's nodes and tags, Profile's path and grade tag, Stats' ring funnel and "admitted".

outer-core.is: Outer Core students (Transcenders). People's nodes and tags, Profile's path and grade tag, Stats by start year. Keep it no lighter than common-core.

alumni.is: Alumni. People's nodes, tags, Stats by start year; a pale fill, always drawn with alumni-edge.

alumni-edge.is: The edge that draws alumni (nodes, tags, bars): change it with alumni.

frozen.is: Frozen (inactive) accounts. Stats by start year; pale, drawn with an outline.

black-hole.is: Blackholed accounts. People's nodes (dashed), Stats' donuts (ran out of days), the ring funnel and by start year.

ok.is: OK and passed: an evaluation's OK badge, a passed mark or exam, validated projects, Stats' donuts (passed), Who evaluated you, flags by month.

outstanding.is: Outstanding: its badge, Stats' donuts (passed with 3 Outstandings), Who evaluated you, reciprocity bars, flags by month. Keep it darker than ok.

fail.is: Failed and negative flags: a 0 or a mark under 80, negative flag badges, failed attempts, Stats' donuts (failed), the reds of why attempts fail start here; delete buttons.

_what.accent: The band, buttons and what is live (the 42 blue; a coalition colour replaces it when chosen).
_what.accent-data: Series that only count (heatmaps, data bars): the accent a step darker in light mode.
_what.accent-ink: Text and focus rings in the accent's colour, readable on the ground.
_what.done: A passed project on your Holy graph (nodes, lit lines, the rings of milestones done).
_what.done-deep: The ring of a project passed with a bonus on your Holy graph.
_what.on-done: Text on done (a passed project's name).
_what.why-cheat: Why attempts fail: cheat or a forbidden function (the darkest red).
_what.why-norme: Why attempts fail: the Norm flag.
_what.why-other: Why attempts fail: other negative flags (the lightest red).
_what.why-marks: Why attempts fail, no flag: evaluation marks under 50 (the darkest grey).
_what.why-exam: Why attempts fail, no flag: an exam under the pass mark.
_what.why-auto: Why attempts fail, no flag: the automatic grading (inferred).
_what.why-none: Why attempts fail, no flag: closed without an evaluation (the lightest grey).
